scope: I1-I6 only; concise static code review and small CPU checks

findings.problem: Launcher reset reward grounding to round0 on recovery and could skip the completed milestone refit.
findings.resolution: Launcher loads persisted live binding and enforces the required reward round at recovery; missing version at the exact milestone is refit before the next outer, and incompatible later state is rejected.

findings.problem: Deterministic round directory with exist_ok=False blocked recovery after partial fitting failure.
findings.resolution: Each fit now writes a unique round-attempt UUID directory. A completed fit atomically publishes its round complete pointer before live; recovery validates run, round, actor version, model path, manifest SHA and both head SHAs, then restores live without refitting. Incomplete attempts remain evidence and do not block a new attempt.

checks_previously_executed.detail: Six modules parsed before the latest grounding-only recovery change; no GPU imports or runtime execution. Latest recovery change was subsequently reviewed by source inspection.

Called actual logical_pair_objective with the actual compute_policy_loss function extracted from its source AST; CPU float64 inputs include unequal row lengths, an empty logical pair, positive and negative advantages and clipping.

Executed actual append_chunk and first_action_cut helpers with a 20-token pause and original ID/logprob continuation. Closing tag and extra suffix sharing one token preserve the whole native token while execution text ends at the closing tag; stored selected logprobs remain unchanged.

static_contract_observations.I1: QA uses shared training action/state helpers and context4096/action500/reserve500 with early final and information-wrapper-preserving observation clipping; score_tokens strict path unchanged.
static_contract_observations.I2: Eight logical two-row masked means retain their authorized weights across physical micro sizes, including local1 fallback.
static_contract_observations.I3: Separate actual-actor grounding refits at50/100/150 produce both commit and boundary heads using canonical300/G5 and are adopted for the next outer; selection probe remains distinct.
static_contract_observations.I4: Fixed four length-stratified trajectories per rank are monitored before and after each minibatch; finite threshold excursions are diagnostic and actual nonfinite values remain fatal.
static_contract_observations.I5: Training BF16 compute with FP32 master/Adam state and QA BF16 engine.
static_contract_observations.I6: QA shares native snapshot, stream action stopping/cropping and retained-token state logic with training; same-prefix continuation retains original policy IDs and selected logprobs.

latest_followup: Reviewed only the new grounding recovery publication/reuse logic on followup. Did not rerun existing mathematical or stream checks and did not add tests.
caveat: Static and small CPU review is not GPU execution, end-to-end training, checkpoint acceptance or evidence of 200 completed outers.
